messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — sprint planning: we need to slice the econ-assisted inference guidance work. customers pushing on batching/caching recs + quantization advice + eval-triggered alerts. goal: ship a small, testable surface in 2 weeks.

Cameron Lee: sketching rough T-shirt estimates: batching policy UI ~3d, backend heuristics ~4d, eval-alerts core ~5d (alpha), quant rec engine ~6d. Can likely do 2 of these comfortably.

Priya Singh: From design: customers want a small checklist + quick toggle. For eval-alerts we can ship a minimal rule editor and sample prompt set. Visuals can be very lightweight.

Juan Alvarez: Important: define acceptance criteria up front. For eval-alerts alpha I want: 1) alert fires on regression in top-1 quality for a curated prompt set, 2) dashboard shows snapshot + diff, 3) durable event in audit logs.

Oliver Nash: infra constraints: if we enable continuous evals at scale we need ephemeral runners or risk spike on Dedicated. Alpha should be rate-limited + throttled by customer. Also require a fallthrough circuit breaker.

Maya Patel: Agreed. Proposal: ship this sprint — (A) batching policy UI + backend heuristics (MVP) and (B) eval-triggered alerts alpha but behind an opt-in flag and limited to pilot customers. Quant rec engine deferred to next sprint. Thoughts?

Cameron Lee: +1. That gives us a backend chunk and a monitoring chunk. I recommend we scope heuristics to two heuristics: dynamic batch sizing by seq-dist and prefix cache hits. Keep config surface tiny.

Priya Singh: UX note: batching UI should show expected latency/cost delta estimates for a sample workload. We can fake realistic estimates for alpha using the offline profiler.

Juan Alvarez: For pilot gating, who are the customers? We have ACME and FinCo asking. We should onboard 1 low-volume + 1 mid-volume. Also add a simple SLO: alert fuzziness threshold (e.g., delta > 4% top-1).

Maya Patel: I'll coordinate pilot invites. Draft acceptance criteria for this slice: 
- Batching: UI + 2 heuristics implemented, integration test + perf benchmark showing <=10% median latency regressed and >=15% token-cost improvement in synthetic case.
- Eval-alerts alpha: rules editor + run-on-demand + one scheduled run; alerts recorded in audit logs and dashboard diff view. Opt-in + pilot-only.
- Docs + SDK sample for toggling feature flags.

Cameron Lee: dev checklist: PRs with unit tests, e2e that runs a small workload, perf harness script in repo under `/tools/profiler/` and a canary job in deploy pipeline.

Oliver Nash: Ops items: add circuit breaker config and quota isolation per tenant. I'll add a Canaries playbook entry and a rollback runbook snippet.

Maya Patel: Customer asks prioritized: 1) ACME wants cost estimates per-route, 2) FinCo cares about audit logs + KMS compatibility for alerts payloads. Both fit alpha gating.

Priya Singh: UI microcopy: call the feature "Inference Guidance (alpha)" and surface a short tooltip: "Automated batching & cache suggestions; eval alerts for regressions". Small.

Juan Alvarez: Quick sample config to include in docs (for engineers/pilot):
```
alerts:
  - name: quality-regression
    prompt_set: acme_smoke_v1
    metric: top1_accuracy
    threshold: -0.04
    run_schedule: cron(0 4 * * *)
```

Maya Patel: Nice. I'll file pilot invites, draft the acceptance checklist, and schedule a 30min kickoff tomorrow. If no objections by EOD we cut the sprint slice.

Cameron Lee: No objections. I'll start on the heuristics prototype branch.

release-bot: CI status — pr/opt-guidance-proto: tests/pipeline passed, perf/quick-check failed (flaky), rerun queued.

Maya Patel: Perfect. Next actions: Maya -> pilot invites/docs; Cameron -> heuristics proto; Priya -> UI wire; Oliver -> ops runbook; Juan -> sample prompt sets + metrics. We'll reconvene 24h after kickoff. :thumbsup:
